result.brief: 提出 SCION，在单一像素空间编码器中联合自监督对比表征学习与流匹配生成，用 [CLS] 语义表征自条件生成并学习嵌入先验，无需标签或预训练模型。
result.reason: Joint self-supervised representation learning and flow-matching generation in one pixel-space encoder, with [CLS] semantic latents and learned embedding prior—directly relevant to representation learning and generative latent spaces.
